A  New  Era  of  Academic  Collaboration:  AIT-IITGN  Double  Degree  Launch  Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar (IITGN), India, and Asian Institute of Technology (AIT), Thailand, have jointly started double master’s degree programmes (hereafter referred to as AIT-IITGN Double Degree Programme) from Academic Year 2025-26, with the first batch of students joining in August 2025. The salient feature of the programme includes a credit transfer framework and the award of degrees by both the institutes. About  IITGN  IIT Gandhinagar was founded in 2008 and is located in Palaj, Gandhinagar, Gujarat, on the banks of the river Sabarmati. IITGN is rated India’s first 5-star GRIHA LD (Green) campus for minimizing the negative impact on the environment. The campus has been declared India’s first 5-star campus for ensuring food safety and promoting healthy eating. The institute promotes critical thinking and an appreciation of the interdisciplinary character of knowledge, with an emphasis on the liberal arts, project-oriented learning, compulsory courses in design and the life sciences, diversity, and globalization. About  AIT  The Asian Institute of Technology (AIT) is an international institution, focusing on engineering, environment, and management studies. AIT’s rigorous academic, research, and experiential outreach programs prepare graduates for professional success and leadership roles in Asia and beyond.
